newsitem.title: USA: N.J. to file anticompetitive suit against Trump.
newsitem.headline: N.J. to file anticompetitive suit against Trump.

text.p: A New Jersey agency will file a lawsuit accusing Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc. of anticompetitive behaviour, an agency source said Monday.
The source said the Casino Reinvestment Authority would not comment until the complaint was filed later Monday.

Trump Hotels sued the casino authority last month, alleging the agency's part in financing a $330 million tunnel in Atlantic City violates a state constitutional amendment permitting casinos in New Jersey.

The tunnel project is being financed in part with casino agency bonds. Donald Trump has opposed the project, arguing it gives rival casino developers, most notably Steve Wynn, unfair competitive advantages. The tunnel would provide access to Wynn's proposed Mirage Resorts Inc. hotel in the marina district.

Authority officials said last month they were considering a range of options to counter the lawsuit, including the anticompetitiveness complaint. Trump Hotels officials were not immediately available for comment.
